items.title: Order

customer.description: Name or identifier of the customer who placed the order.

total.description: Total purchase amount for the order.

currency.description: Currency code used for the order total.

shop.description: Identifier or name of the shop where the order was placed.

items.description: Order entity containing purchase and customer details.

orders.description: List of orders returned for the current page.

pageSize.description: Actual number of order records returned in this page.

maxPageSize.description: Upper limit on the number of order records that can be requested per page.

pageSizeCapped.description: Indicates whether the requested page size was reduced to maxPageSize.

query.description: Search term applied to filter the orders, or null if no query was provided.

description: Paginated list of orders matching the request criteria.
